thread.title: Douglass finishes second at SoCon wrestling championship; Presbyterian places ninth
thread.title_full: Douglass finishes second at SoCon wrestling championship; Presbyterian places ninth

author: s. w. gutierrez
title: Douglass finishes second at SoCon wrestling championship; Presbyterian places ninth
text:
Junior wrestler Reed Douglass of Presbyterian College reached the finals of the Southern Conference (SoCon) Championship in Asheville, North Carolina, becoming only the second athlete from the school to do so. Competing in the 184-pound weight class, Douglass finished as runner-up after losing to top-seeded Tomas Brooker from Appalachian State by a major decision score of 12-3.
Presbyterian College placed ninth overall in the team standings at the tournament. In addition to Douglass’s performance, Christian Anderson (157 pounds) and Brandon Jacoby (165 pounds) both advanced to the consolation quarterfinals but were eliminated by opponents from Chattanooga and Davidson.
Douglass was one win away from completing an undefeated 10-0 record in SoCon competition and securing an automatic spot at the NCAA National Championships scheduled for later this month in Cleveland. He will now wait for a possible at-large bid announcement.
Appalachian State won the overall team title at the SoCon tournament, with UTC and Bellarmine rounding out the top three teams.
